heroHeadline: Russia Bombards 9 Ukrainian Cities Overnight; Kyiv, Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv Hit as Ukraine Strikes Russian Command Posts Near Donetsk
heroSubtitle: Russia launched an hours-long aerial barrage overnight into August 27 on nine Ukrainian cities — including Kyiv, Odesa, Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv, Poltava, and Kryvyi Rih — with ballistic missiles, an Oniks anti-ship missile, Banderol cruise missiles, and Shahed-type drones; Ukraine's air defense downed or suppressed 1 Oniks, 7 ballistic missiles, 3 Banderol missiles, and 222 drones. A 78-year-old woman was killed in Zaporizhzhia Oblast and another person died in Kharkiv Oblast, with 14+ wounded nationwide including 3 children. That afternoon, a separate Russian drone strike killed 1 and injured 5 at a Kharkiv shopping mall. Ukraine's Armed Forces struck Russian army command posts near occupied Donetsk with cruise missiles, targeting facilities OSINT analysts assess may have housed a Russian 51st Combined Arms Army command post. Separately, Ukraine's Economy Ministry downgraded its 2026 GDP growth forecast from 1.3% to roughly 0.5%, citing Russian strikes on energy, logistics, and port infrastructure. Russian cumulative personnel losses reached approximately 1,482,150 by August 27, per the Ukrainian General Staff.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN OHCHR, ISW, CSIS, Ukrainian MoD, US DoD, NATO, IAEA, EU Council, UK MoD, and major news outlets including Reuters, BBC, AP, Al Jazeera, CNN, Bloomberg, Kyiv Independent, Ukrinform, Ukrainska Pravda, Kyiv Post, Euronews, PBS NewsHour, GlobalSecurity.org, United24 Media, Wikipedia War Timeline, and the Ukrainian General Staff. Casualty figures are estimates; Russia has never released official figures.
